'''ME-K4''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] who resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]<ref name="On the Run" /> around [[3623 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.6}}</ref> During the [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Akaavi Spar]]'s [[Mission to Tatooine (Third Galactic War)|mission]] to Tatooine to locate [[Jemala Ha'rangir]], a [[Hidden Chain]] [[Desertion/Legends|defector]], Akaavi asked if the droid had transported a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]]. The droid first denied access to the information. After Akaavi transferred the usual fee, ME-K4 revealed that the defector had gone to the [[Northern Jundland Wastes]], though the droid could not provide a more specific location.<ref name="On the Run" />

==Behind the scenes==
ME-K4 first appeared in the ''Galactic Threads'' storyline released in Game Update 7.8: ''Pursuit of Ruin'', released on [[December 9]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251209-2|text=Game Update 7.8 "Pursuit of Ruin" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
